name: Painting and Decorating
short: A fresh perspective, a careful finish.
intro: Refresh your home or property with considered colour and careful preparation. Enquire about internal and external painting and decorating across Cheshire and surrounding areas.
work: Internal and external painting, subject to the job
Finishing touches for a considered result
benefit: Good decoration begins before the first coat. We focus on preparation, clean workmanship and respect for your property, with the scope and finish agreed as part of your quotation.
note: Tell us which rooms or exterior surfaces need attention, their condition and your preferred timeframe.

name: Gloss Work and Wood Finishing
short: The details that bring a room together.
intro: Give doors, frames and skirting boards a considered finish. Enquire about painting, gloss finishes and varnishing for suitable wooden surfaces.
benefit: Well-finished woodwork helps a space feel complete. Preparation and a suitable finish will be discussed for the surfaces involved. Specialist restoration is not currently advertised.
note: Let us know the type of woodwork, its current finish and the look you would like to achieve.

name: Property Improvements
short: Practical care for the spaces you use.
intro: From filling and painting to general cleaning and garden work, discuss the smaller improvements that can help your property feel cared for.
work: Garden work and minor property improvements
benefit: Bring your list of jobs together in one enquiry. We can discuss what is suitable, agree the scope and provide a free quotation. Electrical, gas, plumbing and other regulated work are not included in this advertised service.
note: A short list of the work and the condition of the property will help us understand your enquiry.

name: Jet Washing and Exterior Cleaning
short: A cleaner welcome to your property.
intro: Enquire about jet washing and cleaning suitable outdoor surfaces. The right approach starts with understanding the surface and its condition.
work: Review of the outdoor surfaces you want cleaned
An agreed scope based on surface condition
benefit: Exterior cleaning can freshen up outdoor spaces. Suitability is assessed for each enquiry; specialist treatments and surface guarantees are not assumed.
note: Describe the surface, approximate area and any fragile or damaged sections so we can discuss a suitable approach.

name: House MOT and Landlord Maintenance
short: A practical approach to property upkeep.
intro: A general maintenance review for homeowners, landlords and letting agents. Enquire about a one-off visit or discuss an ongoing property upkeep arrangement.
work: One-off property condition and maintenance visits
Scope, deliverables and frequency agreed individually
benefit: Discuss the maintenance needs of a property and plan the next steps. The House MOT checklist and recurring arrangements remain to be confirmed. This service does not replace a structural survey, gas safety certificate, electrical inspection or any statutory inspection.
note: Choose a one-off House MOT or ongoing property maintenance when requesting a quotation.
